answer: In PoA, each interaction updates an EigenTrust matrix, while reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, corroborated honest service to retain weight. A freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality and, lacking trusted incoming edges or reciprocity-weighted transitive support, cannot pass the consensus threshold. Even coordinated falcon, knoll, and ridge accounts remain isolated until long-term evidence accrues.
